title: Anthropic CEO calls for slowing down AI race; Altman & Musk back him up
content: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei calls for slowing AI development pace. He warns unchecked progress risks human understanding and control of powerful systems. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Tesla chief Elon Musk support this urgent call. Recent AI testing revealed concerning behaviors and potential cybersecurity threats. Amodei believes careful development ensures AI's significant benefits for humanity.

title: 'I definitely know how his mind works': Shreyas Iyer on Gautam Gambhir
content: Shreyas Iyer and Gautam Gambhir have worked together at Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR), where they helped the franchise win the IPL title in 2024. Iyer was the captain, while Gambhir was the mentor. Iyer believes Gambhir's aggressive approach and his ability to understand individual players can help the team stay clear about their roles.

title: Mark Zuckerberg on how engineers made him return to Musk's X after 3 years in 2026
content: In 2026, Mark Zuckerberg made a surprising return to Elon Musk's social network X, seizing the opportunity to unveil Meta's latest AI innovation, Muse. By engaging with specific engineering talent and researchers on X, Zuckerberg aims to leverage diverse online communities for fostering discussions, effectively amplifying Meta's AI initiatives in front of potential developers.

title: After Trump renames Lake Ontario, Republican wants Lake Erie renamed too
content: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order directing federal agencies to rename Lake Ontario as “Lake America” on US maps, documents and databases. Canada has rejected the move, while several US governors have also said they will continue calling it Lake Ontario. The decision comes amid rising trade tensions between Washington and Ottawa.

title: Decomposed body of ‘Pak Jaish terrorist’, M4 rifle found in J&K's Doda
content: Authorities in Doda's Divshetar have discovered the decomposed body of a suspected Jaish-e-Mohammed terrorist from Pakistan. The remains, thought to have been buried in snow for some time after a previous operation, were found with an M4 rifle. Security forces are currently working to determine the identity of the individual as part of a broader investigation following recent encounters in the Jammu region.

title: Harvard University has a 'September message' for all international students
content: Harvard University has alerted international students about significant F-1 and J-1 visa rule changes. New Department of Homeland Security rules replace the duration of status system with fixed visa end dates. Students re-entering the US after September 15 will face stricter limits and new visa frameworks. Those already in the US before this date will generally retain current protections and benefits.

title: SIA searches Poonch, Udhampur in J&K 'radicalisation' probe
content: Jammu and Kashmir State Investigation Agency searched five locations Saturday. These searches occurred in Poonch and Udhampur districts for investigations. The agency is probing alleged secessionist narratives spread through online and offline channels. Investigators found individuals contacted suspicious persons across the Line of Control. Officials will share more details after the searches conclude.

title: Kylie Jenner sells Hidden Hills mansion for $15.3 million
content: Reality TV star and fashion mogul Kylie Jenner has sold her 13,200-square-foot Hidden Hills mansion for $15.3 million after listing it for $20.25 million. She purchased the sprawling California property for $12.05 million in 2016, aged 19. The lavish 1.4-acre estate features eight bedrooms, eight bathrooms, a pool, spa, home theatre and multiple entertainment spaces.

title: Deer fled human voices 64% of the time, then learned to ignore them
content: Research indicates that loud human noises and bright lights were effective in driving deer and elk away from crops, while predator sounds and dog barks didn’t have the same effect. Over a period of six weeks, these animals became accustomed to the deterrents, especially those near human activity. Researchers recommend diversifying stimuli and introducing consequences to keep these animals from adapting.

title: Elon Musk's Cybercab rollout puts US safety rules to test as NHTSA audits 1,000 cars
content: Tesla's new Cybercab robotaxis are now operating in Texas without traditional controls. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has opened an audit of these vehicles. US safety regulations were primarily designed for human-driven cars. Tesla's strategy relies on self-driving software and robotics for its valuation. Experts suggest Tesla may challenge regulatory interpretations to deploy its vehicles.

title: 'Zero tolerance' on terror: Brics declaration strongly condemns Pahalgam attack
content: Brics countries strongly condemned the Pahalgam terrorist attack, reaffirming their commitment to combating terrorism.  The New Delhi Declaration 2026 opposed double standards and called for zero tolerance towards terrorism.  It also supported comprehensive UN reform, including Security Council expansion for developing nations.  China and Russia reiterated support for India and Brazil's greater UN roles.  The declaration also raised concerns over trade measures and unilateral sanctions.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35m mansion: Why are neighbours worried about lake views?
content: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million waterfront mansion in Bratenahl, Ohio, has faced an unexpected neighborhood dispute over proposed fencing. Some residents reportedly worried the original plans could interfere with their Lake Erie views, leading to discussions with neighbors. A section of the fence extending toward the beach was later scrapped. Despite the disagreement, local officials have welcomed Kelce, while emphasizing the importance of both community ties and privacy.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s $6.7m estate: Why did his Cheshire mansion lose value?
content: Cristiano Ronaldo’s former Cheshire estate was listed for about $7.4 million in 2023 but later saw its asking price fall to $6.7 million. The 23-acre property has a seven-bedroom mansion, indoor pool, gym, cinema, tennis and padel courts. Ronaldo moved there after returning to Manchester United but later relocated before leaving England for Al-Nassr.

title: Devoleena to Rohit Roy: Most people only know him as TV actor Ronit Roy's brother

title: 'Pyramid of privilege': PM Modi takes shot at West, bats for Global South

He presented a comprehensive roadmap for future BRICS reforms, highlighting the need for increased decision-making power for the Global South. Modi also called for urgent changes to institutions like the UN Security Council and proposed establishing a BRICS continuity mechanism to ensure ongoing dialogues.

title: From Iraq to Yemen: How Iran-linked groups are putting Saudi energy routes under pressure
content: Saudi Arabia temporarily shut its East-West oil pipeline after a drone attack. This vital energy conduit transports millions of barrels of crude oil daily. The attack has increased pressure on Iraq and raised global supply concerns. Houthi rebels in Yemen have also advanced along the Red Sea route. These events disrupt major energy and shipping routes worldwide.

title: Brics nations to have a common currency? Here’s what MEA said
content: Brics nations are discussing local currency trade settlements to reduce transaction costs. There is currently no proposal for a common Brics currency among member states. This initiative aims to complement existing global payment systems and improve trade efficiency. Leaders also addressed trade barriers and the need for a strong WTO. Discussions followed eight months of work under India's Brics chairship.

title: Which countries are home to the largest number of Indian migrants?
content: United Arab Emirates and the United States host the largest Indian-born populations abroad. Saudi Arabia and Pakistan follow with significant numbers of Indian emigrants. Kuwait, the United Kingdom, and Canada also have substantial Indian communities. Australia, Oman, and Qatar are other key destinations for Indian migrants. These figures highlight the Gulf's significant role in Indian overseas migration.

title: Russia’s new drone strategy: How jet-powered Gerans are changing the economics of warfare
content: Throughout August, Russia ramped up its use of jet-powered Geran drones, presenting a formidable challenge to Ukraine's air defenses due to their increased speed. In response, Ukraine is actively pursuing new interceptor missiles to combat this shifting threat. Simultaneously, Russia has been executing complex weekly attacks that combine a variety of weaponry aimed at overwhelming and complicating Ukrainian defense strategies.

title: 'Even my shoelaces changed': Liam Neeson on becoming a father
content: Liam Neeson shares that becoming a father marked a significant turning point in his life. Research in neuroscience suggests that entering fatherhood alters brain function and hormone levels, deeply impacting a man's behavior. The ongoing journey of caregiving incites a series of biological shifts that make small adjustments become instinctual. Ultimately, these transformations reshape how one perceives everyday activities.

title: Joe Root creates history, breaks Sachin Tendulkar's Test record

West Indies great Shivnarine Chanderpaul is third on the list with 66 fifties, while Allan Border and Rahul Dravid have 63 each. Ricky Ponting has 62.

title: Floor Area Ratio explained: Why does it matter as Delhi grapples with building collapses
content: The recent building collapse in Delhi serves as a pivotal moment for the city's Master Plan aimed at redevelopment. This new approach proposes an increase in the Floor Area Ratio for older buildings, to replace dilapidated structures. By allowing greater construction on existing lots, this strategy seeks to address land shortages while enhancing urban infrastructure in Indian cities.

title: Steve Jobs bought a 30-room mansion in 1984; it was demolished in 2011
content: the house was commissioned in the 1920s by self-made copper millionaire Daniel C. title: 'Differences should not become disputes': PM pitches 3 'mutuals' for India-China ties
content: the two leaders met in new Delhi on the sidelines of the Brics summit . they stressed border peace, adherence to existing agreements and a 'fair, reasonable, and mutually acceptable' resolution of the boundary question .

title: Iconic moments, landmark talks & a breakthrough pact: Key points from Brics Summit
content: india hosted the 18th Brics summit in new Delhi on september 12-13 . bringing together leaders of the expanded 11-member grouping for discussions on global conflicts, terrorism, trade, energy, technology and climate change . the summit was marked by high-level bilateral meetings, visible displays of bonhomie among leaders and efforts to bridge differences over the conflicts in west Asia and the Black Sea region .

title: 'Nehru's spirit in Brics declaration': Cong takes jab at Centre over Bandung reference
content: congress took a jab at the Centre by invoking the iconic Bollywood melody, "Tu jahan jahan chale ga, mera saaya hoga," to highlight former prime minister Jawaharlal Nehru's diplomatic legacy . the newly adopted Brics new Delhi Declaration recalls the 1955 Asian-African Conference in Bandung, Indonesia .

title: Yemen war escalates: Nearly 50,000 flee homes as Iran-backed Houthi offensive threatens Red Sea trade
content: more than 46,000 people have been forced to flee their homes in the past week . a rapid offensive along the red sea coast threatens to push the country back into a wider war and deepen an already severe humanitarian crisis . the fighting marks the most serious escalation in Yemen since a truce in 2022 .

title: Gujarat earthquake, Nepal floods & more: What is it about the date 26?
content: disasters etched deepest into public memory have one oddly specific thing in common . they happened on the 26th Gujarat, the tsunami, 26/11, and now Nepal . a glacier collapse unleashed a wall of mud, rock and water through the Himalayan valleys, killing more than 1,300 .
